_comment: The one MCP source of truth for every harness, per rules/decisions/2026-09-22-mcp-list-by-industry-and-use-case.md and rules/decisions/2026-09-22-config-layout-no-personal-layer.md ('MCP の一覧(四つの形)'). One file, no layers, no packs. `targets.<harness>` means 'the generator should emit this server for that harness'. Values must be `${VAR}` references, never literal secrets (enforced by src/domain/mcp/parse.ts at load time). Claude Code does not read MCP servers from ~/.claude/settings.json (docs: mcp.md); its user-scope source is ~/.claude.json, which only `claude mcp add` writes. The generator NEVER touches ~/.claude.json: `jig apply --target claude` prints one `claude mcp add --scope user` line per targets.claude server for the owner to run by hand, and a server registered there under a name this file no longer has is removed once, by hand, with `claude mcp remove` (the decision's '初回の移行で claude mcp remove を手で行う'); detecting that duplication is explicitly not a generator feature.

servers.name: serena

omp._comment: serena-agent ships no 'omp' context; 'codex' is the closest fit — both are headless tool-calling CLIs.

servers._comment: Kept: symbol-level search and edit. Claude Code's LSP plugin only reports diagnostics, so the roles do not overlap.

servers.name: codebase-memory-mcp
servers._comment: Kept: the code graph. The vendor's '99% reduction' claim is unverified — measure it in jig's own audit.

servers.name: context7
servers._comment: Kept, and widened to every harness that has MCP at all: version-pinned documentation injection ('Codex だけでなく MCP を持つ全ハーネスに配る').

servers.name: playwright
servers._comment: claude=false on purpose: Claude Code has claude-in-chrome natively. dsh=false because dsh loads MCP schemas eagerly into every request, so it gets only serena, codebase-memory and context7. Pin bumped 0.0.32 (2025-07) → 0.0.82 on 2026-09-23: pi-mcp-adapter 2.37.0 rejected 0.0.32's tools/list (every inputSchema.type failed 'expected object'); 0.0.82 is the registry's latest (https://registry.npmjs.org/@playwright%2Fmcp).

servers.name: figma-remote
servers._comment: Kept: there is design work to receive. figma-desktop was dropped by the same decision. pi=false since 2026-09-23: Figma's remote MCP needs a pre-registered OAuth client — pi-mcp-adapter's Dynamic Client Registration is refused (HTTP 403), measured; Claude Code and Codex run their own OAuth flow.

servers.name: notion-mcp
servers._comment: Kept: read and write Notion from inside the coding work.
